A hand-traced building outline carries its own tracing error, and this pipeline models observation uncertainty but declares no footprint uncertainty anywhere. The 0.71 m discrepancy is comfortably inside normal OSM outline error and well outside the observation's sigma, so the contradiction most likely lies in the footprint, which this lane has no authority to move.
